name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat near the hips.
Drive through the heels to lift the hips.
Squeeze the glutes at the top; body straight from knees to shoulders.
Lower with control.

name: Good Morning
steps: Rest the bar across the upper traps, hands securing it.
Brace the core and hinge at the hips, chest lowering toward the floor.
Keep knees soft and back flat throughout.
Extend the hips to return upright.

name: Hammer Curl
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at the sides, palms facing each other.
Curl the weights up without rotating the wrists.
Keep elbows pinned to the ribs.
Lower under control.

name: High Knees
steps: Stand tall, core braced.
Drive one knee to hip height, then the other, in a running rhythm.
Stay on the balls of the feet; pump the arms.
Keep the torso upright throughout.

name: Plyometric Push-Up
steps: Start in a tight plank, hands under the shoulders.
Lower the chest to the floor with the elbows at about 45 degrees.
Drive explosively so the hands leave the floor.
Land with soft elbows and go straight into the next rep.

name: Jumping Jack
steps: Stand tall, arms at the sides.
Jump the feet wide while sweeping the arms overhead.
Land softly on the balls of the feet.
Jump back to the start and repeat rhythmically.

name: Kettlebell Swing
steps: Hinge at the hips and hike the bell back between the legs.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Keep the arms relaxed; the hips do the work, not the shoulders.
Let the bell fall and hinge again as it passes the knees.

name: Lateral Raise
steps: Stand with dumbbells at the sides, slight elbow bend.
Raise the arms out to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly — no swinging.

name: Forward Lunge
steps: Step one leg forward into a split stance.
Lower straight down until both knees are near 90°.
Keep the front knee over the ankle and torso upright.
Push off the front heel to return.

name: Overhead Press
steps: Hold the bar at the front of the shoulders, grip just outside shoulder width.
Brace and press the bar straight overhead.
Lock out with the bar over the mid-foot, head through.
Lower with control back to the shoulders.

name: Overhead Squat
steps: Press the bar overhead with a wide grip, arms locked.
Squat down while keeping the bar stacked over the mid-foot.
Keep the chest up and push the bar toward the ceiling throughout.
Stand up without letting the bar drift forward.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind the head by bending the elbows.
Keep the elbows tight and pointing forward.
Extend the arms back to lockout.

name: Pistol Squat
steps: Stand on one leg, the other leg extended in front, arms forward.
Sit down slowly on the standing leg, keeping the heel planted.
Go as deep as balance allows without the knee caving in.
Drive back up through the whole foot.

name: Plank
steps: Set forearms under the shoulders, legs extended.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace the abs and glutes; don't let the hips sag.
Breathe and hold.

name: Push-Up
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Lower the chest to just above the floor, elbows ~45° from the body.
Keep the body rigid from head to heels.
Press back up to full lockout.

name: Reverse Lunge
steps: Stand tall, then step one leg straight back.
Lower until both knees reach ~90°, torso upright.
Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.

name: Romanian Deadlift
steps: Hold the bar at the hips, feet hip-width, soft knees.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down the thighs.
Keep a flat back; feel the stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive the hips forward to stand, squeezing the glutes.

name: Sit-Up
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, hands by your temples.
Brace and curl the torso all the way up to the knees.
Keep the chin off the chest and avoid pulling on the neck.
Lower with control, one vertebra at a time.

name: Barbell Snatch
steps: Wide grip, hips low, chest over the bar.
Drive with the legs, then extend the hips violently.
Pull yourself under the bar and receive it overhead in a squat.
Stand up with the bar locked out overhead.

name: Bodyweight Squat
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out, arms forward for balance.
Sit the hips back and down, chest up, until thighs reach parallel.
Keep knees tracking over the toes and heels planted.
Drive through the heels to stand tall.

name: Sumo High Pull
steps: Wide stance, toes out, narrow grip on the bar.
Drive the hips forward and pull the elbows high and wide.
The bar travels close to the body up to chin height.
Lower under control back to the start.

name: Sumo Squat
steps: Take a wide stance, toes out 30-45°, dumbbell hanging between the legs.
Squat down keeping the torso upright and knees pushed out.
Descend until thighs are parallel.
Squeeze the glutes and inner thighs to stand.

name: Superman
steps: Lie face down, arms extended overhead.
Lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor together.
Squeeze the lower back and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without dropping.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Slide down a wall until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Knees at 90°, directly over the ankles.
Press the whole back flat against the wall.
Breathe and hold.

name: Barbell Back Squat
steps: Bar across the upper back, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Brace, then sit the hips back and down, chest tall.
Descend until the thighs are at least parallel, knees over toes.
Drive the floor away and stand tall without leaning forward.

name: Bent-Over Row
steps: Hinge to ~45° with a flat back, bar hanging at arm's length.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs, elbows driving back.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control without losing the hinge.

name: Bicep Curl
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at the sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up, keeping elbows pinned to the ribs.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, hands by your temples, legs lifted.
Drive one knee in while rotating the opposite elbow toward it.
Extend the other leg straight, hovering above the floor.
Alternate sides in a smooth pedalling rhythm.

name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat down and plant both hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back into a plank and lower the chest to the floor.
Push up, jump the feet back under the hips.
Explode up into a jump, arms overhead, and land softly.

name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart.
Rise onto the balls of the feet as high as possible.
Pause at the top, squeezing the calves.
Lower slowly under control.

name: Clean and Jerk
steps: Pull the bar from the floor and extend the hips.
Drop under and rack the bar on the front of the shoulders.
Dip a few inches and drive the bar overhead.
Split or squat under, lock out, and recover to standing.

name: Crunch
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands by the head.
Curl the ribcage toward the pelvis, shoulder blades off the floor.
Exhale at the top; don't pull on the neck.
Lower slowly.

name: Deadlift
steps: Stand with the bar over the mid-foot, hands just outside the legs.
Hinge and bend the knees to grip the bar with a flat back.
Drive through the floor; bar stays against the legs.
Lock out tall, then lower along the same path.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
steps: Hold dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press both weights straight overhead.
Lock out without shrugging; keep the core braced.
Lower with control back to the shoulders.

name: Front Raise
steps: Hold dumbbells in front of the thighs, palms down.
Raise straight arms to shoulder height.
Keep the torso still; no leaning back.
Lower under control.
